title: Camp Oljato

services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: The Pacific Skyline Council operates one camp, Boulder Creek Scout Reservation, available for rental. It comes equipped with an industrial kitchen, campsites, and pristine woodland views in the Santa Cruz Mountains. Host your next corporate retreat, group campout, or school trip just outside the Bay Area! For day use, our Palo Alto Service Center and Fire Circle offer a quiet meeting space and room for a bonfire, s'mores, and roasting hot dogs! Our Foster City Service Center offers conference room space to host meetings for your unit-from Committee Meetings to PLC planning meetings and more. Pacific Skyline Council units can reserve campsites at Boulder Creek Scout Reservation

blurb: Since 1941, Camp Oljato has shaped generations of Scouts through challenge, friendship, and the magic of the High Sierra.
